input.summary:
Implemented a Task Management API using Node.js built-ins and TypeScript with in-memory stores and an event bus.

Files:
- src/types.ts: Shared type definitions per OpenAPI schema.
- src/event-bus.ts: In-memory pub/sub EventBus.
- src/services/user-service.ts: User service with CRUD.
- src/services/project-service.ts: Project service with CRUD and member management.
- src/services/task-service.ts: Task service with CRUD, assign, and forward-only status changes. Publishes events.
- src/services/comment-service.ts: Comment service with create/list/get/delete and publishes comment.added events using provided getters.
- src/services/notification-service.ts: Subscribes to events and creates notifications; list and mark read.
- src/router.ts: Single HTTP router using Node's http module implementing all OpenAPI endpoints and wiring services via EventBus. No direct service-to-service calls (comment service receives data via injected getters).
- src/main.ts: Entry point to start the server.
- src/demo.ts: Demo script that starts the server on port 3001 and exercises the full flow (create users, project, add members, tasks, assign, status changes, comments, notifications).
- tsconfig.json and package.json configured. TypeScript compilation passes with `npx tsc --noEmit`. Demo runs with `npx tsx src/demo.ts`.

All constraints satisfied and the system compiles cleanly.
